Class EnvironmentalKernel

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.dod.EnvironmentalKernel
public class EnvironmentalKernel extends Object
Data-Oriented Environmental Kernel.

Models ecological biomass regeneration, agricultural yields, and natural resource decay governed by smooth ($C^\infty$) differential equations anchored in Farquhar C3/C4 Photosynthesis kinetics (FvCB), Priestley-Taylor Potential Evapotranspiration (PET), Lieth (1975) Miami NPP, continuous topographic slope retention, and physical capital intensification (AGENTS.md Â§3, Â§10.1, Â§10.2).

Mathematically synchronized with native/ether-core-native/src/environmental.rs.

    calculateBeerLambertCanopyTransmission(float leafAreaIndex, float extinctionCoeff)
    Calculates Beer-Lambert canopy light transmission fraction $I / I_0 = \exp(-k_{\text{ext}} \cdot \text{LAI})$.
    static float
    calculateMiamiNPP(float tempC, float effectivePrecipMm)
    Computes smooth ($C^\infty$) Net Primary Productivity (NPP in $\text{g DM}/\text{m}^2/\text{yr}$) analytically via the Lieth (1975) Miami Climate Model using soft-minimum coupling: $$\text{NPP}(T, P) = \text{softmin}\!\left(\frac{3000}{1 + \exp(1.315 - 0.119\,T)},\; 3000\,(1 - \exp(-0.000664\,P))\right)$$
